source_analysis.skill: Determine rank from a stated pivot-column count (easy) or subtract non-pivot count from total columns (moderate).
reasoning_steps: Identify matrix dimensions and whether stated columns are pivots or non-pivots.
For easy recall rank equals pivot count; for moderate compute columns minus non-pivots.
invariants: Five distinct numeric radio options with exactly one correct answer.
Easy items give pivot count; moderate items give non-pivot count.
No row reduction or explicit matrix computation is needed.
permitted_variations: Matrix name, dimensions, pivot count/rank and non-pivot count within feasible bounds.
Square, tall and wide dimensions; zero and full rank are mathematically valid conservative boundary extensions.
Correct-option location and distractor values/bank profiles may vary.
Dimensions are irrelevant to easy response once feasibility is assured; moderate column count and non-pivot count are relevant.
Fixed target rank(A) and one correct radio choice are essential; particular letter, dimensions, rank, answer position and source bank are incidental.
